performance_claims.scope: Qwen2.5-14B BF16, B1-B32, frozen StateAxis 2026-08-16 3+3 matched run
performance_claims.result: All six runs were token-exact and lifecycle-clean; candidate applied 279 decisions and replays per run with zero fallback/rebuild. The post-hoc paired throughput 95% interval crosses zero, so no material benefit or stable slowdown is claimed; the active ECPA revision remains performance-unqualified.
